debrief db-021
1) the ac-t-o-r d-e-s-i-g-n-e-d a f-a-k-e p-e-r-s-o-n-a with a f-a-l-s-e b-i-o g-r-a-p-h and l-e-f-t a d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
2) they c-r-a-f-t-e-d m-e-s-s-a-g-e s-e-q-u-e-n-c-e-s to b-u-i-l-d t-r-u-s-t and l-e-f-t c-h-a-t l-o-g-s in the d-a-t-a-base while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the p-r-i-v-a-c-y r-e-v-i-e-w
3) the ac-t-o-r r-e-q-u-e-s-t-e-d e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y p-a-y-m-e-n-t-s from v-i-c-t-i-m-s and l-e-f-t f-i-n-a-n-c-i-a-l r-e-c-o-r-d-s in the t-r-a-c-k-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n a-u-d-i-t
4) they r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-d m-o-n-e-y m-u-l-e-s to m-o-v-e f-u-n-d-s and l-e-f-t c-o-n-t-a-c-t l-i-s-t-s in the n-e-t-w-o-r-k while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the a-c-c-o-u-n-t c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e
5) the ac-t-o-r u-s-e-d p-s-y-c-h-o-l-o-g-i-c-a-l t-a-c-t-i-c-s to k-e-e-p v-i-c-t-i-m-s s-i-l-e-n-t and l-e-f-t p-e-r-s-u-a-s-i-o-n t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e-s in the f-o-l-d-e-r while s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the e-t-h-i-c-s c-o-n-s-u-l-t
